caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object that resembles a decorated panel or box lid with a latch at the top center. The main composition features a central horizontal band: on the left, there is a person with brown skin, wearing a blue jacket and white pants, shown kneeling and holding the hands of a child in a pink dress. To the right, there is a black horse facing right, with a small animal—possibly a dog or goat—standing beneath the horse’s head. The background is a muted reddish-brown color. Surrounding this central scene, there is a symmetrical arrangement of large, stylized floral patterns in circular forms, predominantly red, pink, and white with blue accent flowers and swirling black, green, and teal leaves. The corners are filled with these floral motifs. The outermost border consists of a darker, wavy brown line. At the bottom of the image, there are swatches of paint colors used in the drawing, ranging in shades of black, browns, reds, pinks, blues, and white. The entire drawing is outlined by a simple black and brown rectangular frame.
title: Chest
